name: Cuba
description: Cuba is a Russian ransomware group (unrelated to the country) active since approximately 2019, targeting critical infrastructure sectors including finance, government, healthcare, and IT. Despite the name, the group is Russia-based. The FBI issued advisories in 2021 and 2022, noting Cuba compromised at least 49 US critical infrastructure entities and collected over $60 million in ransom payments from more than 100 victims worldwide.
